optional_keys_absent.systemd_unit:
[Unit]
Description=Solstone Supervisor
After=default.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=<LAUNCHER_BIN> supervisor <PORT>
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
Environment=HOME=<HOME>
Environment=PATH=<PATH>
Environment=_SOLSTONE_JOURNAL_OVERRIDE=<JOURNAL>

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

optional_keys_present.systemd_unit:
[Unit]
Description=Solstone Supervisor
After=default.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=<LAUNCHER_BIN> supervisor <PORT>
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
Environment=ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<API_KEY:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY>
Environment=GOOGLE_API_KEY=<API_KEY:GOOGLE_API_KEY>
Environment=HOME=<HOME>
Environment=OPENAI_API_KEY=<API_KEY:OPENAI_API_KEY>
Environment=PATH=<PATH>
Environment=PLAUD_ACCESS_TOKEN=<API_KEY:PLAUD_ACCESS_TOKEN>
Environment=REVAI_ACCESS_TOKEN=<API_KEY:REVAI_ACCESS_TOKEN>
Environment=_SOLSTONE_JOURNAL_OVERRIDE=<JOURNAL>

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
